brief:
Republicans have intensified their criticism of Abdul El-Sayed ahead of the midterm elections, according to Zeteo. The outlet characterizes the campaign against the Arab-American politician as rooted in bigotry and warns that attacks are poised to accelerate as November draws closer. Observers cited by Zeteo suggest the targeting reflects broader anti-Arab sentiment reshaping electoral politics.

Zeteo also reported a recent Israeli military operation affecting a Palestinian-American, citing the incident as part of a widening pattern. The outlet links the attack to escalating tensions surrounding Arab and Palestinian identity amid the midterm season, suggesting the convergence of foreign policy and domestic political rhetoric is shaping how Arab-Americans experience the current electoral cycle.
dek: Republicans have declared a bigoted war on Abdul El-Sayed and it's only going to ramp up as November gets closer, writes Mehdi. Plus, we report yet another Israeli attack on a Palestinian-American.
title: Republicans escalate campaign attacks on Arab-American politician El-Sayed
